entries.0375db58ee0bb26b: Under its mission of 'Improve ROI with autonomous AI,' the company will work on the following medium- to long-term management strategies: continuous strengthening of AI technology and development of new solutions; acquisition of new customers; growth of revenue from existing customers; further penetration of the Asia-Pacific region, expansion into the United States and Europe, and expansion into new regions; and pursuit of external growth opportunities through strategic M&A.
entries.086f3916fe8710f1: The company cites as its strengths: continuous innovation in AI technology using deep representation learning, automated machine learning, online real-time learning and transfer learning; management with AI expertise and business experience; network effects in which combining multiple solutions increases the data the AI learns from and raises prediction accuracy; expansion of its product range through strategic acquisitions; and a customer base across diverse industries and regions.
entries.0db277411a6cfd2e: It is a business model that provides autonomous AI solutions to customers including consumer-facing service companies, using three clouds: advertising, personalization and data.
